answer: A bond is refunded only after 50 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The pigment counter is kept in tundra and jade exposes each reset. Someone as a result has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 50 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 2055 identities would post 1510 proofs and burn roughly 21 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
